title: Allow pausing a subscription over the holidays
body: Customers have asked about pausing deliveries while they travel in December. Add `POST /subscriptions/{id}/pause` with a resume date.

title: Persist subscriptions in a database
body: Subscriptions are only kept in memory, so they disappear when the server restarts. Pick SQLite for now and add a `subscriptions` table. Marcus Lee will pick this up after the Nov 10 storefront launch.
